name: Up until the end
source:
This was supposed to be an ordinary day, in an ordinary life. But it isn’t. You were in the town library, reading a good book when…You don’t really remember. You know you passed out. When you wake up, you are surrounded by flames !

Will you get out of danger? Will you create bond with your companions? And maybe, will you find love on the way?

[From [url=https://letigame.itch.io/up-until-the-end]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这本该是平凡的一天，平凡的生活。但事实并非如此。你在镇图书馆里读一本好书，但……你不太记得了。你知道你昏倒了。当你醒来的时候，你已经被火焰包围了！

你能脱离危险吗？你会与你的同伴建立联系吗？也许，你会在路上找到爱情吗？

[来自[url=https://letigame.itch.io/up-until-the-end]Itch.io[/url]]
